name: Gnosia
author: c-wenlong

control._comment: `primary` is the web app: the studio runner is first in stop order but only exists while STUDIO_ENABLED=1, so it must not be the part whose state the phone reports. Stop order: the diagram studio runner first (a systemd user unit that only exists while STUDIO_ENABLED=1 in services/gnosia-learn/.env, hence optional, and the one that talks to both the app's node_modules and the database), then the Next.js app (systemd user unit). Start is the reverse. A stopped app stays stopped across deploys — deployd's re-run rebuilds and migrates but only restarts the app, and the runner, if they were running.

description: Gnosia study hub: the private c-wenlong/self-learn repo's Next.js roadmap and Claude tutoring loop over a catalog that is one SQLite file under the data root — courses, concept notes, spaced-repetition reviews, indexed videos and diagrams. Native `next start` under a systemd user unit on 127.0.0.1:8107 behind Serve; no database server runs. deployd polls the remote every minute and re-runs setup.sh when main moves (stop app, npm ci, migrate, next build, start), and a nightly 03:00 timer exports the catalog to the data root's archive/ (~/.gnosia by default, ~/.self-learn on installs that predate the rename). Sign-in is the app's own OWNER_PASSWORD from .env — the tailnet is still the perimeter, the password just gates one owner from another tailnet device.
